problem.title: Minimum Absolute Difference Pairs
problem.problemStatement: Given an array of integers, find all pairs having the minimum absolute difference after sorting.
problem.input: • First line contains integer N. • Second line contains N integers.
problem.output: Print all pairs with the minimum absolute difference in ascending order.
